source_caption:
Queen & Slim (2019) is a crime drama following Queen and Slim, two strangers whose first date takes an unexpected and life-changing turn. While driving home, they are stopped by a police officer, and a sudden confrontation forces them to make a decision that changes the course of their lives.
Now on the run, Queen and Slim travel across the country while trying to figure out what to do next. As their story spreads, they become the subject of intense public attention, with different people viewing their actions in completely different ways.
The journey brings the two strangers closer together as they confront fear, uncertainty, love, identity, and the consequences of their choices. What began as an uncomfortable first date gradually becomes a deeper connection formed under extraordinary circumstances.
The film explores themes of race, justice, survival, love, identity, and the way society can shape the story surrounding a single event. Queen and Slim are forced to confront not only the law chasing them but also what their journey represents to the people they encounter.
What makes Queen & Slim compelling is the transformation of two ordinary people caught in an extraordinary situation. Their journey becomes both a fight for survival and an unexpected exploration of who they are.
More than just a crime drama, Queen & Slim is a story about two people whose lives change in one night and the complicated journey that follows.
💬 What would you do if one unexpected moment changed your entire life?

source_details.synopsis: Queen & Slim is a 2019 American romantic road crime drama film directed by Melina Matsoukas (in her feature directorial debut) and with a screenplay by Lena Waithe from a story by James Frey and Waithe. The film tells the story of a young couple (Daniel Kaluuya and Jodie Turner-Smith) who go on the run after killing a police officer, in self-defense, in the heat of an argument during a traffic stop that had quickly escalated. Bokeem Woodbine, Chloë Sevigny, Flea, Sturgill Simpson and Indya Moore also star.
